war_summary: War 139 is on day 104 with no winner. Colonials hold a commanding strategic lead (approximately 175 bases to Wardens' 65) across 40 regions. The hottest combat zones are Endless Shore, Callahans Passage, Oarbreaker, Clahstra, Godcrofts, and Stema Landing, where both factions are suffering high casualties with accelerating trends and active base flipping. Endless Shore shows the highest intensity (2,200+ casualties/hr per side) with 48 events/24h and 5 most active bases. Callahans Passage follows with 1,500+ casualties/hr per side and 6 events/24h. Oarbreaker leads in event volume (52 events/24h) with rapid base turnover across 5 bases. Clahstra has 21 events/24h with 3 highly active bases. Godcrofts shows 24 events/24h with accelerating casualties. Stema Landing has 7 events in the last 2 hours with 2 active bases. Wardens hold quiet northern regions (Basin Sionnach, Clanshead, Howl County, Viper Pit, Weathered Expanse, Speaking Woods, Reaching Trail) but face heavy pressure in Speaking Woods (565 colonial/452 warden casualties in 2h). Large Colonial rear areas (Deadlands, Drowned Vale, Allods Bight, etc.) are quiet with minimal casualties.
